block.prompt:
Your teacher reads a short dialogue aloud TWICE. Then decide: are the sentences below true (T) or false (F)? Write the correct information for false statements.

[Teacher reads:]
Mrs Green: "Good morning, Tom. Could you please hand out these worksheets to the class?"
Tom: "Sure! How many are there?"
Mrs Green: "Twenty-five. And please put one on every desk before the lesson starts."
Tom: "No problem. Should I collect the old worksheets too?"
Mrs Green: "Yes, please. Put them on my desk."

statements: Mrs Green asks Tom to collect the worksheets.
Tom should put the worksheets on the teacher's desk.
Tom needs to do this after the lesson.

block.answer_key: 1. F — She asks him to hand OUT the worksheets (and collect the OLD ones). 2. T. 3. F — He puts them on every desk. 4. F — Before the lesson starts.
block.acceptable_reasoning: Schüler:innen dürfen sinngemäß korrigieren, nicht wörtlich.
watch_outs: Statement 1 ist eine klassische Verwechslungsfalle: 'hand out' vs. 'collect' — beide kommen im Text vor
Statement 3 und 4 prüfen Details zur Zielaktion; auf genaue Formulierung achten
